projects.name: Feature Foundry
projects.summary: Native Foundry workspace, durable store and preserved-source recovery tooling coexist in Athena.

gates.label: Preserved audit
gates.detail: The 2026-11-14 audit explicitly records retirementReady=false, preserved history and selected release files.

gates.label: Windows and Linux checkpoint and fork
gates.detail: The portable launcher can checkpoint both stopped stores and open a separate fork, preserving the original pair. Hosted Windows and Linux exercised this with synthetic stores; this does not verify owner data, physical media, or all older releases.

gates.label: Reviewed legacy import and event preservation
gates.detail: Windows and Linux CI tested a stopped Feature Foundry v24 snapshot, exact soundtrack values by theme and room, and optional original event export to a separate local file. These were synthetic tests. The archive is not active history, and the import does not cover all legacy records.

gates.label: Native and rights acceptance
gates.detail: Complete native parity, owner-target acceptance, and privacy/rights review remain separate gates. Historical release inventory is not native runtime verification.

gates.label: Owner data and remaining legacy records
gates.detail: Compare an independent stopped copy of the owner’s data before cutover. Custom catalog records, media fidelity, unsupported historical data and rights still need their own acceptance. Preserve the original.

evidence.label: Portable import, original event archive and limits

projects.name: Project Constellation
projects.summary: Athena Projects tracks owned ideas and followed work. Continuity keeps source-attributed notes, revisions and explicit evidence dependencies.

gates.label: Native continuity slice
gates.detail: Integration documentation distinguishes the reconstructed 0.20.1 baseline from incomplete staged 0.20.2 recovery. It is not a full extension port.

gates.label: Reviewed project staging
gates.detail: The local v7 picker passed Windows and Linux with synthetic backups. It stages only selected live workspace names and exact timestamps with explicit ownership and stage. The saved Projects roster must still match before confirmation. Provider mirrors, notes, chats and approval history are not copied.

gates.label: Owner-target project migration
gates.detail: Keep the original export and test an independent stopped copy from the intended device. Do not infer full project history, provider coverage, account synchronization or data cutover from a synthetic staging test.

gates.label: Remaining source capabilities
gates.detail: Browser capture, pause/resume, remote synchronization, grants and source history/release reconciliation require their own scoped verification. No approval automation is imported.

evidence.label: Continuity capabilities, provenance and remaining gates
